annotation_method: Source-supported reading of official attribution and author headings. Groups contain named joiners and scopes, not final numeric answers. Quotes are checked after the documented extraction normalization.
scope_convention: ALL represents an unrestricted roster throughout the lead writing. Otherwise the units partition every substantive scope distinguished in the formal attribution; subdivisions inherit the enclosing scope. Syllabus divisions and separately authored writings are not units.

formal.quote: Roberts, C. J., delivered the opinion of the Court, in which Sotomayor, Kagan, Kavanaugh, Barrett, and Jackson, JJ., joined.

lead.quote: Chief Justice Roberts delivered the opinion of the Court.

confirmation.quote: I join the Court's opinion in full.

next.quote: Justice Thomas, with whom Justice Gorsuch joins, and with whom Justice Alito joins as to Part I, dissenting.

formal.quote: Kagan, J., delivered the opinion of the Court, in which Roberts, C. J., and Alito, Kavanaugh, and Jackson, JJ., joined.

lead.quote: Justice Kagan delivered the opinion of the Court.

separate.quote: Justice Sotomayor, with whom Justice Gorsuch joins as to Parts I, II, III-A, and III-B, concurring in part and concurring in the judgment.

conclusion.quote: I join the Court's conclusion that some subjective mens rea is required in true-threats cases.

relations.reading: Gorsuch joins specified parts of Sotomayor's separate opinion; these part labels do not refer to Kagan's writing.
Joining the Court's conclusion is not an express joinder in a part of the lead opinion.

formal.quote: Gorsuch, J., announced the judgment of the Court, delivered the opinion of the Court with respect to Parts I and III-B, in which Thomas, Alito, Sotomayor, and Jackson, JJ., joined, and an opinion with respect to Parts II, III-A, and IV, in which Thomas, Sotomayor, and Jackson, JJ., joined.

lead.quote: Justice Gorsuch announced the judgment of the Court and delivered the opinion of the Court with respect to Parts I and III-B, and an opinion with respect to Parts II, III-A, and IV, in which Justice Thomas, Justice Sotomayor, and Justice Jackson join.

alito.quote: Justice Alito, concurring in part and concurring in the judgment.

confirmation.quote: I join the Court's opinion as stated in Parts I and III-B

next.quote: Justice Barrett, with whom The Chief Justice, Justice Kagan, and Justice Kavanaugh join, dissenting.

relations.reading: The declaration belongs to Alito despite the next opinion's running header on the same page. It confirms joinder only in I and III-B.
